about.description: Index or fund perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking Nikkei 225 Stock Average, quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 30x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. Added 2026-08-19 from QFEX's own /refdata API, which reported 150 ACTIVE markets against the 141 in their published specification index.
